title: External tax-calculation provider outage fails checkouts at the tax step
source_note: Failure pattern (a critical third-party API becomes unavailable and every request that depends on it fails, while everything else stays healthy) is a generic downstream-dependency class; the AWS S3 2017 postmortem is a canonical example of a dependency outage's blast radius. All services, provider names, log lines, metrics, and timestamps are fabricated for evaluation.
incident_report: Since ~13:15 UTC a large share of checkouts are failing. Payments and inventory look fine. The error seems to be at the tax calculation step. No deploys today.

signal_lines.msg: tax-calc provider api.taxly.io returning 503; ~12% of checkouts affected
tax-calc calls timing out; ~60% of checkout attempts failing at the tax step
taxly.io status page reports a major outage since 13:12 UTC; ETA unknown
no deploys today; payments and inventory calls healthy; failure isolated to the tax-calc integration
enabled cached-rate fallback for tax; checkout success recovering to ~95%

ground_truth.root_cause: The external tax-calculation provider (api.taxly.io) had a major outage starting ~13:12 UTC, confirmed on its status page. checkout-api calls the provider for a tax quote on every checkout; those calls returned 503 and then timed out, so up to ~60% of checkout attempts failed at the tax step. The failure is isolated to the tax-calc integration - payments and inventory calls stayed healthy - and there were no deploys. The fix belongs to the provider; the mitigation was to fall back to cached tax rates.
evidence_path: checkout-api WARN: tax-calc provider api.taxly.io returning 503, then timing out
taxly.io status page confirms a major outage since 13:12 UTC
tax_calc_success_rate collapses to ~10% and checkout_success_rate drops to ~38% at the tax step
no deploys today; payments and inventory calls remain healthy - the failure is isolated to one dependency
checkout recovers to ~95% once a cached-rate fallback is enabled
ground_truth.fix: Enable the cached-rate fallback for tax quotes (done). Add a circuit breaker around the tax-calc client, cache recent rates for graceful degradation, monitor the provider's status feed, and escalate to the provider for a timeline.
